title: 第10章 囚字劫起万界囚第11章 劫字重生新朝立
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、劫外棋动·囚笼降世
中天棋盘的「囚」字棋位化作黑洞，吞噬各劫界的「自己」。
沈墨卿望着劫界裂缝中挣扎的儒门弟子，惊鸿剑上的七情道心珠突然发烫，映出初代守秤人立于劫外的身影——他手持「惊」字道心珠，周身缠绕着由恐惧凝成的锁链。
初代守秤人·太昊玄渊：
「吾乃太昊氏初代守秤人太昊玄渊，今以七情为锁，囚天下道心——凡抗拒者，皆入劫狱！
」他抬手挥锁链，各劫界天空降下「恐惧暴雨」，接触者会看见自己最害怕的未来。
诗号：
「七情为狱念为墙，万劫如锁世如筐。
太昊玄渊今再立，敢教天地入囚房！
恐惧具现：
-萧素雪看见沈墨卿的道骨竹节枯萎，惊鸿剑断裂为「仁」「权」两半；
-元晦目睹伽蓝寺被魔火焚毁，佛骨舍利清莲化作骷髅；
-凌九霄预见大胤百姓揭竿而起，龙气被踩在泥沼中；
-风九幽和百里无霜看见蛊井中的试药人集体复活，将他们拖入深渊。
二、跨劫援救·分线破局
五派决定兵分五路，进入不同劫界阻止「囚」字位吞噬：
沈墨卿·儒门分裂劫界：
他踏入血流成河的明心院，楚轩行的「权术派」弟子举刀砍来，刀刃刻着「杀尽清流派」。
-新招式·七情·思无邪：
惊鸿剑七色剑光交织成「思无邪」结界，净化弟子眼中的劫外符文：「仁权本非对立，为何执迷杀戮？」

-心魔对决：
幻象中的楚轩行冷笑：「因为「仁」救不了乱世——只有「权」能！
」沈墨卿挥剑斩向幻象，却见剑刃映出自己手持「权」字笔的模样。
萧素雪·黑化劫界：
这里的她已与劫外者联手，劫心琴化作断头绳，测天丝缠绕着沈墨卿的咽喉。
-劫心琴·七弦·破茧：
她弹奏《破劫引》残章，测天丝残片斩断断头绳：「道心若灭，破劫何意？」黑化的自己瞳孔闪过一丝清明，助她找到劫界核心的「恐惧源」。
元晦·佛魔劫界：
八大明王法相堕魔后屠尽伽蓝寺，元晦面对昙无谶的尸体，降魔杵发出鬼泣。
-佛谒·灭度·慈航：
他将佛骨舍利清莲放入昙无谶掌心，诵念往生咒：「今日贫僧代众生受劫，愿地狱空，众生度。
」佛光中，堕魔明王们双手合十，化为尘埃。
content_en:
1. The chess move outside the robbery and the arrival of the cage
The "prison" chess position on the Zhongtian chessboard turned into a black hole, swallowing "self" in each calamity realm.
Shen Moqing looked at the Confucian disciples struggling in the cracks in the calamity world. The Seven Emotions Dao Heart Bead on the Jinghong Sword suddenly became hot, reflecting the figure of the first generation Scale Keeper standing outside the calamity - he was holding the "Jing" Dao Heart Bead with the word "Jing" in his hand, and his body was wrapped with chains made of fear.
The first scale keeper Taihao Xuanyuan:
"I am Taihao Xuanyuan, the first scale-keeper of the Taihao clan. Now I use the seven emotions as a lock to imprison the Taoist hearts of the world - anyone who resists will be sent to prison!
” He raised his hand and waved the chain, and a “storm of fear” fell from the sky in all tribulation realms. Those who came into contact would see the future they feared most.
Poetry number:
"The seven emotions are like a prison and thoughts are like a wall, and all the tribulations are like a locked world like a basket.
Taihao Xuanyuan is standing again now, dares to teach heaven and earth to enter the prison cell!
Fear manifests:
-Xiao Suxue saw Shen Moqing's Dao bones withered, and the Jinghong sword broke into two halves of "benevolence" and "quan";
- Yuan Hui witnessed Jialan Temple being burned down by demonic fire, and the Buddha's bone relics turned into skeletons;
-Ling Jiuxiao foresees that the people of Dayin will rise up and the dragon spirit will be trampled into the mire;
- Feng Jiuyou and Baili Wushuang saw the drug testers in the Gu well resurrected collectively and dragged them into the abyss.
2. Cross-tribulation rescue and branching to break the situation
The five factions decided to divide their troops into five groups and enter different tribulation realms to prevent the "Prison" character from being devoured:
Shen Moqing·Confucianism split the world:
He stepped into the Mingxinyuan where there was a river of blood. A disciple of Chu Xuanxing's "powerful sect" came at him with a knife, and the blade was engraved with "Kill all the Qing sect".
-New moves·Seven Emotions·Siwuxie:
The seven-color sword light of Jinghong Sword interweaves into the "Si Wu Xie" barrier, purifying the tribulation runes in the eyes of disciples: "Benevolence and power are not antagonistic, so why are you obsessed with killing?"
-Demon showdown:
Chu Xuanying in the illusion sneered: "Because 'benevolence' cannot save troubled times - only 'right' can!"
Shen Moqing swung his sword towards the illusion, only to see that the sword blade reflected the image of himself holding a pen with the word "quan" in his hand.
Xiao Suxue·Blackened Tribulation Realm:
Here she has joined forces with the Jiewai, the Jiexinqin has turned into a rope, and the Tiansi silk has been wrapped around Shen Moqing's throat.
-Jie Xin Qin·Seven Strings·Broken Cocoon:
She played the fragments of "Breaking the Tribulation", tested the fragments of Tensilk and cut off the severed headband: "If the Taoist heart is destroyed, what's the point of breaking the calamity?" A glimmer of clarity flashed through her blackened pupils, helping her find the "source of fear" at the core of the calamity world.
Yuanhui·Buddha-Demon Tribulation Realm:
After the eight great Ming kings fell into demons, they slaughtered all the Jialan Temple. When Yuan Hui faced Tan Wujue's corpse, he subdued the demon pestle and let out ghostly cries.
-Buddha's Visit·Nirvana·Cihang:
He placed the pure lotus relics of the Buddha's bones into the palm of Tan Wu Zhen's hand, and recited the mantra of rebirth: "Today, this poor monk suffers calamity on behalf of all sentient beings. May the hell be empty and be saved by all sentient beings."
"In the Buddha's light, the fallen demon kings clasped their hands together and turned into dust.
